h1.en: Diesel 40 Concrete Pump keeps its own figures; Gasket is only the picture
h1.zh: 为什么柴油40型混凝土泵不印活塞行程保留自己的数字，「墊片」只是配图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The row does list Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油40型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。这一行标出了理论输送量26 m³/h和最大出口压力25 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket. The picture shows Gaskets. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a piston stroke, a cycle rate or a squeeze gap for the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai. The frame “Mobile crane” shows Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD and adds no stroke figure. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112. It is not a measured stroke for Diesel 40 Concrete Pump.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket。画面是Gaskets。河北品锦机械没有在邢台的柴油40型混凝土泵这一行标出活塞行程、冲次或挤压间隙。柴油40型混凝土泵这一行不会把那些名称变成扭矩、小时间隔，或这一行没有写出的材料牌号。

body.en: The row does list Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa. The wear-part list elsewhere names pistons and swing-arm parts as replacement sizes. Main-unit weight is 2800 kg. Theoretical Output 26 m³/h.
body.zh: 这一行标出了理论输送量26 m³/h和最大出口压力25 MPa。主体：Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD。

body.en: A piston displaces concrete into the line. a squeeze pump compresses a hose. This Diesel 40 Concrete Pump row does not turn those names into a torque, an hour interval or a material grade beyond what this row already lists. Subject: Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD. Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa.
body.zh: 画面「Mobile crane」的主体是Maeder-Kriessern-Rhine-Liebherr LR 11000-32ASD，也没有补上行程数字。如果画面里能看到活塞或阀，那只是这一帧的主体。

body.en: The sheet does not choose between them by inventing a stroke. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. If a piston or valve is visible there, that is the subject of the frame. Pipeline length still has to be read from this model's own distance entries, not from the frame and not from a different pump.
body.zh: 另一份易损件清单用外径列出活塞和摆臂类替换件。管路长度仍要读这个型号自己的距离格，不读这一帧，也不读另一台泵。

question.en: Does Diesel 40 Concrete Pump list a piston stroke?
question.zh: 柴油40型混凝土泵标出了活塞行程吗？

answer.en: No. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket.
answer.zh: 没有。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 那标出了什么工作参数？

answer.en: Theoretical Output 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure 25 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket.
answer.zh: 理论输送量26 m³/h，最大出口压力25 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. Hours, torque and price stay unprinted. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket.
answer.zh: 没有。小时、扭矩和价格都没有标出。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gasket画面里印出的数字。
